description: Send the person's request to BuildWright so a person calls them back. Use for any documentation, filing or compliance task, listed or not. Before calling: ask the person for each field in conversation (name, their own 10-digit Indian mobile, optionally email, what they need, entity type, state). Never invent or guess a phone number or name. Then ask explicitly whether BuildWright may contact them about this request, show the privacy policy https://buildwright.co.in/privacy-policy, and set consent to true only if they say yes.

consent.description: true only after the person explicitly agreed to be contacted

email.description: Email, only if the person gave one

name.description: The person's full name, as they gave it

need.description: What they need done, in their words (required when no service_id)

notes.description: Anything else they want us to know

phone.description: The person's own 10-digit Indian mobile number, as they gave it

service_id.description: An id from list_services, if the need matches one

name: request_service
title: Request a callback from BuildWright
